candidates: The unsubscribe action uses TopicUser.find_by which returns nil if no record exists for the user-topic combination, then calls tu.notification_level without a nil check, causing a NoMethodError when users click unsubscribe links for topics they've received notifications about but never directly viewed

The route is defined as topicUnsubscribe (a top-level route), but the template is placed at templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs instead of templates/topic-unsubscribe.hbs, causing Ember's resolver to not find the template and rendering the unsubscribe page blank or broken
